name: fleetbase-screenshots
description: Deterministic console screenshot capture for the fleetbase.io image library.
//: Every dependency is pinned EXACTLY, with no ^ or ~, and that is load-bearing.
sharp bundles libwebp: a patch bump re-encodes every screenshot byte-differently,
which would present as ~32 changed files in a pull request that contains no real
UI change. playwright is pinned for the same reason (its bundled Chromium is the
rasterizer) and is asserted against PLAYWRIGHT_IMAGE_TAG in src/determinism.mjs.
Bumping either is a deliberate act that produces one large, expected churn PR.
